# Workspace Engineering Instructions

This is a production repository, not a tutorial sandbox.

Use `AGENTS.md` as the cross-agent operating contract. Apply the rules in `.github/instructions/` and read `docs/engineering/` before making architectural, data-model, security, integration, or workflow assumptions.

Core expectations:

- inspect before editing;
- preserve established architecture and repository structure;
- use existing project conventions rather than generic examples;
- verify behavior with the repository's real tests/checks;
- never overwrite unrelated user work;
- surface uncertainty instead of inventing facts.
